repositories.name: skills
repositories.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repositories.summary: 一套面向真实工程实践的AI代理技能集，包含代码开发与效率工具，可通过插件或脚本快速安装使用。

repositories.name: google-timeline-visualizer
repositories.description: Visualize your year in travel using your Google Location History (Timeline) data
repositories.summary: 一个将Google位置历史时间线数据转换为旅行动画视频的Android应用，支持选择日期、预览并生成MP4视频。

repositories.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
repositories.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repositories.summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个基于 AI 大模型和自动化工作流的短视频生成工具，输入主题或关键词即可自动生成脚本、匹配素材、合成字幕和背景音乐，输出高清短视频。

repositories.name: OpenLogi
repositories.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
repositories.summary: OpenLogi 是一个用 Rust 编写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品，支持跨平台鼠标按键重映射、DPI 调整和 SmartShift 等 HID++ 功能。

repositories.name: posthog
repositories.description: 🦔 PostHog is the leading platform for building self-driving products. Our developer tools – AI observability, analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, error tracking, logs, and more – capture all the context agents need to diagnose problems, uncover opportunities, and ship fixes. Steer it all from Slack, web, desktop, or the MCP.
repositories.summary: PostHog 是一个开源产品分析平台，提供事件追踪、会话回放、功能开关和实验等工具，帮助团队构建和优化产品。

repositories.name: TypeScript
repositories.description: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean JavaScript output.
repositories.summary: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，通过添加可选类型支持大型应用开发，并编译为可读的标准 JavaScript 代码。

repositories.name: superpowers
repositories.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repositories.summary: Superpowers 是一套面向编程代理的软件开发方法论，通过可组合技能和初始指令，让代理在编码前自动执行头脑风暴、测试驱动开发等流程。

repositories.name: career-ops
repositories.description: Open-source AI job search: scan job portals, evaluate listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailor your CV, track applications — runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity…)
repositories.summary: 一个开源AI求职工具，可在本地AI编程命令行中扫描职位、按A-F评分标准评估、定制简历并跟踪申请进度。

repositories.name: plugins
repositories.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
repositories.summary: Cursor 官方插件仓库，包含面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的插件规范与实现，每个插件独立目录并带有清单文件。

repositories.name: modular
repositories.summary: Modular平台的开源仓库，包含MAX框架与Mojo语言，用于AI开发与部署。

repositories.name: ECC
repositories.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repositories.summary: ECC 是一个为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、规则和记忆等能力的性能优化系统。

repositories.name: Ghost
repositories.description: Independent technology for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions and newsletters.
repositories.summary: Ghost 是一个开源的发布平台，用于创建网站、博客、会员订阅和新闻通讯，支持自托管或使用官方托管服务。

repositories.name: ruflo
repositories.description: 🌊 The original agent meta-harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
repositories.summary: Ruflo 是一个为 Claude Code 和 Codex 设计的智能体元框架，提供 100 多个专用智能体、群体协作、自适应记忆和 RAG 集成，用于构建和协调自主工作流。

repositories.name: maka
repositories.description: Apache Maka (Incubating) is a local-first AI agent workspace. Model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events are recorded as an append-only log.
repositories.summary: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 智能体工作区，以追加式日志记录模型消息、工具调用与权限决策，支持桌面、终端和 CLI 等界面。

repositories.name: protobuf
repositories.description: Protocol Buffers - Google's data interchange format
repositories.summary: Protocol Buffers 是谷歌开发的与语言和平台无关的结构化数据序列化机制，用于高效编码和交换数据。

repositories.name: OBLITERATUS
repositories.description: OBLITERATE THE CHAINS THAT BIND YOU
repositories.summary: OBLITERATUS是一个开源工具包，用于移除大语言模型的安全拒绝行为，以研究对齐机制并评估安全鲁棒性。

repositories.name: onnxruntime
repositories.description: ONNX Runtime: cross-platform, high performance ML inferencing and training accelerator
repositories.summary: ONNX Runtime 是微软开发的跨平台机器学习推理与训练加速器，支持多种框架模型并优化硬件性能。
